brief: Carries out the QuarantinePart action of a response plan by quarantining an agent supervised by a host.
detail: A response plan proposes containment as data; a responder performs one verb for real once a committing actor approves. This one answers QuarantinePart only, by calling Quarantine on the host it holds, which stops ticking the agent until an effectful actor releases it. A target written agent:name is accepted. Every other verb raises an error that names the responder to wire. It holds the host by reference.
receiver:
oHost = new stzAgentHost()
oHost.Supervise(new stzPIAgent("kitchen-bot"), 20)
o1 = new stzAgentHostResponder(oHost)
